Initial release of ai-research-scraper.

- Provides automated scraping of latest AI research and product updates from major AI websites.
- Delivers concise summaries with direct links to source articles.
- Offers data volume control to ensure quick and focused reading.
- Supports configurable site lists, summary length, date range, and product-centric topics.
- Includes scripts and resources for customization and extension.
